events.title: Official Trailer | Conquer the Labyrinth
events.summary: 100 floors. 10 Epic Bosses. One Labyrinth to conquer. Conquer the Labyrinth is a third-person anime-inspired Action RPG where you battle your way through a 100-floor procedural dungeon filled with dangerous monsters, powerful loot, and challenging bosses. Every 10 floors, a new Epic Boss stands in your way. Grow stronger, develop your skills, craft and upgrade your equipment, discover powerful Relics and Monster Shards, and build your character to match your playstyle. ⚔️ Fight with melee, magic

basic_info.short_description: Conquer the Labyrinth is an anime-inspired third-person Action RPG where you battle through a 100-floor procedural dungeon filled with deadly monsters, powerful loot, and Epic Bosses guarding every portal to the floor below. Grow stronger through crafting, skill progression, and intense combat.
